newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CADETE HITS HAT-TRICK FOR CELTIC.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CADETE HITS HAT-TRICK FOR CELTIC.

text.p: grabbed a hat-trick as Celtic routed Kilmarnock 6-0 in a Scottish premier division match on Wednesday.
Cadete's pace and predatory penalty box instincts ripped the visitors apart in a dazzling show of forward play.
He opened the scoring after 18 minutes, added his second in the 65th and completed his triple strike in the 90th.
The other goals were shared by Jackie McNamara in the 23rd minute, Dane Morten Wieghorst in the 80th and Chris Hay in the 88th.
Second-placed Celtic are 11 points behind city arch rivals and defending champions Glasgow Rangers with a game in hand.
